meaning: Folder of the root node: documentation that crosses every app. Set to None to have no root node.
Who can open /docs/. staff: staff users. authenticated: any signed-in user. public: anyone. A callable receives the request and returns a boolean.
Languages a page can exist in. The first one is the source language.
App labels whose docs/ folder is ignored.
Folders inside an app whose classes docs_codemap lists in addition to models and views.
Build the node tree once per process. When false it is rebuilt on every request.
